decision_policy.final_rejection_rule: Only an explicit structured IRDAI Type Of Product value of Group is sufficient in pass 1 to fail coverage_arrangement against the frozen INDIVIDUAL/FAMILY_FLOATER/BOTH experiment population.
forbidden_inferences: infer regulatory benefit basis from product name
infer domain from marketing words or UIN pattern
infer main-product status from absence of Add On text
infer current offering solely from historical approval date
infer family-floater eligibility from marketing language unless a separately governed source establishes it
decision_policy.individual_rule: An explicit structured Individual value may pass coverage_arrangement only; it does not establish domain, benefit_basis, insurance_object_type, or current_offering.
